notes: This is a river journey by canoe or kayak. You need skills for moving water, or a guide. Wear a life jacket at all times.
There are more than 200 rapids. Most are grade 1 and some are grade 2. Ask your canoe operator which rapids to look at first.
The river can rise fast after rain. Pull the canoes high above the water and tie them at night.
There is no road between Whakahoro and Pipiriki.
Tīeke Kāinga is a marae. Your hosts can welcome you with a ceremony: do what they tell you.
A 3 day journey starts at Whakahoro. Use Change plan to start there.

start.note: The usual start for the 5 day journey. Canoe operators in Taumarunui and Ohakune supply the canoes and the transport.

end.name: Pipiriki
end.note: End of the journey. Your canoe operator collects you here.

pois.name: Bridge to Nowhere
pois.text: A concrete bridge from 1936 in the Mangapurua valley. It was built for a farm settlement that failed. The walk from Mangapurua Landing takes about 1 hour 30 minutes there and back.

pois.name: Ohuraiti Hut
